cashFlows.method: Indirect method. Starts with net income for the period, then walks the change in every non-cash balance sheet account (sourced from posted journal entries) to reconcile to the actual change in cash. Bucketed by account subtype: working-capital changes flow to operating; fixed/other assets to investing; long-term liabilities and equity to financing.
cashFlows.imbalance: Cash flow ({{netChange}}) does not match the change in bank-account balances ({{endingCash}} − {{beginningCash}} = {{delta}}). Difference: {{difference}}. This usually indicates direct journal entries to retained earnings or other equity accounts that bypass the indirect-method assumptions.

salesTax.help: What you owe each tax jurisdiction. Collected = sales tax credited to the “Sales Tax Payable” account on posted invoices. Remitted = debits to the same account (your remittance payments + adjustments). Ending balance = what's still owed as of the To date. Per-rate breakdown comes from non-void invoices billed in the period — fill the columns straight into the state/local remittance form.
salesTax.noAccount: No account named Sales Tax Payable exists yet. Create one in Chart of Accounts (liability / other_current_liability) before invoices with tax can post. Per-rate breakdown still works below.
salesTax.noRates: No active tax rates in this period.
salesTax.tip: Tip: the period total of “Tax collected” should match the GL “Collected” tile above. If they diverge, look for manual journal entries that hit Sales Tax Payable directly — those bypass the per-rate breakdown.

forecast.title: Cash flow forecast
forecast.description: Projects cash position forward from today using current bank balances + open A/R due + open A/P due + active recurring templates. Tax on recurring is approximated as subtotal-only (line totals × quantity); the actual JE on fire will include tax. Forecast is an estimate — payments may land early/late, and unforecast cash events (one-off bills, payroll runs, deposits) aren't modeled.

periodClose.title: Period close
periodClose.description: Lock the books through a specific date so accidental late entries can't disturb a finalised P&L. Posting to dates on or before the close date is rejected at the database layer (the same guard catches API attempts and direct SQL).
periodClose.tip: Typical month-end: pick the last day of the month after you've reviewed and reconciled. Reopening unlocks all closed periods at once; there's no per-month granularity in v1.
periodClose.confirmClose: Close the books through {{date}}? Entries on or before this date will be rejected.
periodClose.confirmReopen: Reopen the books? Anyone with permission will be able to post entries to previously-closed periods.

activity.title: Activity log
activity.description: Append-only audit trail. Every posted journal entry (invoices, bills, payments, payroll, depreciation, disposals, manual entries) writes a row here. Newest first. Rows can never be edited or deleted — DB triggers enforce that.
activity.limitNote: Showing up to 100 rows per query. Tighten the date range or add an action filter to narrow further.
